description: Get exactly the version a stored id names, forever, even after it was superseded or withdrawn: the values, effective dates, citation, verification record and its status today. Version ids (`rv_…`) come from the `id` of any rule response. Use it to re-check the value a decision relied on, or to show an auditor which rule applied. Example: `{"version_id": "rv_000000000000000000000000F2"}`. Informational only, not legal advice.

version_id.description: A version id from a rule response's `id`, e.g. `rv_000000000000000000000000F2`.

name: resolve_version
title: Resolve a version id
